name: PokePulses
description: a vertical short-form video series about Pokémon

voice.instructions: Energetic, natural short-form narrator. Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a surprising discovery with a friend. Crisp, playful, and never rushed. Never imitate a known person or character.
